The Land Awakens.effect: Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) wholly within the creeping overgrowth and more than 9" from all enemy units.

Spirit of The Dark Forest.effect: Halve the target's Move characteristic for the rest of the turn.

Spellsinger.effect:
If this unit is a WIZARD, add 1 to casting rolls for this unit.
If this unit is not a WIZARD, it can use the 'Unbind' ability as if it had WIZARD (1).

Realmroot Guide.declare: This unit can only use this ability if it is wholly within the creeping overgrowth. Pick this unit and up to 1 other friendly SYLVANETH unit within this unit's combat range to be the targets.

branchwych > Slay The Trespassers!.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks that target that enemy unit for the rest of the turn.

treelord_ancient > Eldest Of Elders.effect: Roll a dice for each target. On a 3+, add 1 to hit rolls for that target's combat attacks until the start of your next turn.

warsong_revenant > Wyldwood Revenants.timing: Reaction: You made an unmodified chanting roll of 1 for a SYLVANETH PRIEST wholly within 12" of this unit
warsong_revenant > Wyldwood Revenants.name: Rousing Accompaniment

the_twistweald.base_size: Swarmsage: 40mm, Twistroot Wardens and Twistroot Revenant: 32mm, Twistroot Dryads: 28.5mm, Twistroot Spite-Revenant: 40mm

Our Reach is Long.effect:
The creeping overgrowth (referenced by other abilities) extends 6" from each terrain feature that has a friendly overgrown token.
Increase this range by 1" for each friendly LORDS OF THE CLAN unit that is wholly outside friendly territory.

Song of the Hunt.effect: The following cumulative effects apply to friendly EVERGREEN HUNT units depending on the number of chords you have:

options.name: 1 chord – Simple
options.text: Add 1 to run rolls and charge rolls for friendly units wholly within the same quarter of the battlefield as the quarry.

options.name: 2 chords – Tuneful
options.text: Add 1 to hit rolls and wound rolls for friendly units' combat attacks that target an enemy unit wholly within the same quarter of the battlefield as the quarry.

options.name: 3-5 chords – Melodic
options.text: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly units while they are in combat with the quarry.

options.name: 6+ chords – Mellifluous
options.text: While a friendly unit is in combat with the quarry, the quarry has STRIKE-LAST.
